unit.why: A short anecdote from the account of the master's last illness: a disciple is told the master could recover but sees great darkness in the world, and R. Moshe of Przeworsk visits before his death and gets no answer to his question.
unit.boundary_note: part of a numbered sequence (§§95–97) on the tzaddik's final illness and death; neighbouring divisions continue the same frame

stories.start_quote: והנה אז בימים האלה היה ההק׳
stories.summary_en: During his final illness the master says he could be fully healthy in two days but sees great darkness in the world; his illness is understood as a hidden struggle for all Israel, and when R. Moshe of Przeworsk visits on the Sabbath eve before his death and offers to help, the master does not answer.
